events.name: Bash
events.head: Inspect the local centre code for AI connection routes and check the local stack is up
events.input: $ cd [redacted] 2>/dev/null && pwd && git branch --show-current && ls && (curl -s -o /dev/null -w "local8790 %{http_code}\n" http://localhost:8790/ ; true) && grep -rnoiE "ai[_-]?connections?[a-z_/:-]*|model_map|task_models?|last_error" src --include=*.ts | awk -F: '{print $1": "$3}' | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn | head -40; grep -c . .dev.vars | sed 's/^/devvars lines: /'; cut -d= -f1 .dev.vars

events.name: Bash
events.head: List centre source files and find AI connection code
events.input: $ cd [redacted]; ls src scripts migrations | head -80; grep -rnE "ai_connections|ai/connections|model_map|task_model|last_error" src | cut -c1-220 | head -70

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check wrangler config names, listening local services and the tantra config folder
events.input: $ cd [redacted]; grep -nE "\"name\"|database|vars|routes|workers_dev" wrangler.jsonc | head -20; lsof -nP -iTCP:8790 -sTCP:LISTEN | tail -2; lsof -nP -iTCP -sTCP:LISTEN | grep -E "node|python|workerd" | awk '{print $1,$2,$9}' | sort -u | head -20; ls ~/.config/tantra/ 2>/dev/null

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read the AI connection picker and the admin connection routes
events.input: $ cd [redacted]; sed -n 200,310p src/ai.ts; echo ------; sed -n 520,640p src/index.ts | cut -c1-330

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read how a draft picks its connection and model
events.input: $ cd [redacted]; sed -n 100,200p src/ai.ts | cut -c1-300; grep -nE "ai_model|model_for|models_json|tier|probe|is_test|test_only|walker" src/ai.ts src/settings.ts | cut -c1-240 | head -50; grep -n "admin" src/index.ts | head -20 | cut -c1-200

events.name: Bash
events.head: Sign in to the local admin and read the AI connections and routing settings
events.input: $ cd [redacted]; K=$(grep '^ADMIN_KEY=' .dev.vars | cut -d= -f2- | tr -d '"'); rm -f /tmp/t292.jar; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "enter %{http_code}\n" -c /tmp/t292.jar "http://localhost:8790/admin/enter?k=$K"; curl -s -b /tmp/t292.jar http://localhost:8790/admin/api/connections | python3 -m json.tool; curl -s -b /tmp/t292.jar http://localhost:8790/admin/api/settings | python3 -c "

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find which probes and scripts call the drafting or connections API
events.input: $ cd [redacted]; git status --short | head -15; grep -rlE "api/connections|/draft|routing" --include=*.mjs --include=*.py --include=*.sh --include=*.ts . 2>/dev/null | grep -v node_modules | head -30; grep -n "model\|ai:" cloud/src/generated/*.ts 2>/dev/null | grep -oE "model: ?\"[a-z]+\"" | sort | uniq -c

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find which probes and scripts call the drafting or connections API
events.input: $ cd [redacted]; git status --short | head -15; echo ---; grep -rlE "api/connections|/draft|routing" . --exclude-dir=node_modules --exclude-dir=.wrangler --exclude-dir=.git --exclude-dir=dist --exclude-dir=.next 2>/dev/null | grep -E "\.(mjs|py|sh|ts|tsx|js)$" | head -40; echo ---; grep -rhoE "model: ?\"[a-z]+\"" cloud/src/generated | sort | uniq -c

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read how probes trigger drafts and how the admin renders Model per task
events.input: $ cd [redacted]; grep -nE "connections|/draft|routing|model" app/scripts/probe-clients.mjs app/scripts/probe-context.mjs app/scripts/walk-learn.mjs app/scripts/probe-domain-chain.mjs | cut -c1-220 | head -50; echo ---; grep -nE "routing|Model per task|connections" cloud/admin-ui/admin.js | cut -c1-260 | head -30; echo ---; grep -nE "draft" cloud/src/index.ts | cut -c1-220 | head -20; grep -rhoE "model: \"(opus|sonnet)\"" app/src cloud/src 2>/dev/null | sort | uniq -c

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read the draft route, the routing tab and how probes open browser contexts
events.input: $ cd [redacted]; sed -n 282,312p cloud/src/index.ts | cut -c1-260; grep -n '"routing"' cloud/src/index.ts; sed -n 274,290p cloud/admin-ui/admin.js | cut -c1-500; echo ---; grep -nE "newContext|launch\(|setExtraHTTPHeaders|ORIGIN|origin =" app/scripts/probe-clients.mjs app/scripts/probe-context.mjs app/scripts/walk-learn.mjs app/scripts/probe-domain-chain.mjs | cut -c1-200; grep -rlE "Draft|draft" app/scripts | head -40

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read the live Worker's AI connections and routing (read only)
events.input: $ L=https://revops-centre.growthcluborg.workers.dev; K=$(tr -d '\n' < ~/.config/tantra/revops-admin-key); rm -f /tmp/t292live.jar; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "enter %{http_code}\n" -c /tmp/t292live.jar "$L/admin/enter?k=$K"; curl -s -b /tmp/t292live.jar $L/admin/api/connections | python3 -m json.tool; curl -s -b /tmp/t292live.jar $L/admin/api/settings | python3 -c "

events.name: Bash
events.head: Commit the task board update
events.input: $ git add -- workshop-plan/tasks/tasks.json workshop-plan/tasks/inbox.jsonl && git commit -q -m "Agent T-292: Opus connection re-enabled locally, probes kept on Sonnet/Haiku, live Worker has no AI connections

events.text: T-292 is in review: Opus (connection 1) is enabled locally at top priority and a real-browser draft logged `claude-opus-5-5`, while a probe draft logged `claude-sonnet-5-5` on connection 3 through a new headless/script rule (commit 2c3323a in tantra-onboarding-v2, not deployed); the live Worker has no AI connections, so it was left alone and will need an Anthropic API key before cohort drafting.
